title: Transform Array by Parity
summary: Given an integer array nums, replace each even number with 0 and each odd number with 1.
statement: Given an integer array nums, replace each even number with 0 and each odd number with 1. Then, sort the modified array in non-decreasing order and return the resulting array.
constraints: Replace each even number by zero and each odd number by one.
Sort the transformed values in nondecreasing order.
hints: Count how many input values are even.
Every even value contributes one zero and every remaining value contributes one one.
Sorted binary values place all zeros before all ones.
Constructing those two blocks avoids a comparison sort.
editorial: Constructing those two blocks avoids a comparison sort.

tests.explanation: Two even values become zeros followed by two ones from the odd values.
Every value is even, producing three zeros.
